newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand hits all-time low of 4.65 vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand hits all-time low of 4.65 vs dollar.

text.p: The South African rand on Monday dived to a new record low of 4.6515 bid against the dollar on continued strong speculative demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rand settled at 4.6110/6160 on Friday after breaching the 4.60 level for the first time on downbeat comments from central bank governor Chris Stals.

Stals warned that already high interest rates might have to be raised further if there was no slowdown in money supply and credit growth, and cautioned that the country's low reserves ruled out any early scrapping of exchange controls on residents.
On Monday, Stals said he did not expect an immediate hike in rates following some signs of stabilisation in September money supply data.
